lines.en: I walk slowly through the conifers.

lines.zh: 背板在阳光下排成两列。
lines.en: My plates line up in two rows.
My head rides very low.
The spikes on my tail sway.
My plates rise and fall as I walk.
I cross a layer of pine needles.
Trees brush between my plates.
I follow my herd's path.
I come down the slope slowly.
My shadow trails on the needles.
My tail moves first when I turn.

lines.zh: 背上那排骨板，一步一沉。
lines.en: Every step sinks with these back plates.
I go around a fallen log.
An insect rests on my plate.
Standing, chewing pine needles.
My plates take in the sun.
My tail hangs behind me.
Pine needles fall on my plates.
A herdmate is a few steps off.
I swing my tail to the other side.
These conifers are quiet.
My plates have warmed up.
I rumble low.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪到另一条腿。
lines.en: I shift weight to another leg.
Needles settle on my back.
The plates on my back are hot.
I glance at my own tail.
A branch snapped somewhere.
You're standing behind my tail.
That's not a good spot.

lines.zh: 我的背板不是用来爬的。
lines.en: My plates aren't for climbing.

lines.zh: 我的背比你的头顶还高。
lines.en: My back stands above your head.
My tail spikes only lift a little.
I sniff the wind between the firs.

lines.zh: 我的小脑袋抬起来看你。
lines.en: My small head lifts to look at you.
Two steps back would be better.
I stop beneath the firs.
Pine needles crunch under you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴正好在你那一侧。
lines.en: My tail is on your side right now.

lines.zh: 你别爬到我的背板上去。
lines.en: Don't climb up on my plates.
I swayed, then held.
My plates rattle.
I lower my head, plates toward you.
Thick hide, still painful.
I brace all four legs and stay up.
I can still swing my tail.
Blood drips on the needles.
My herdmates are watching.
A low growl, tail spikes up.
I still haven't fallen.
I eat only plant leaves.
Pine needles will do at a pinch.
I don't eat meat at all.
Hand it over. I can reach.
This is nowhere near enough.

lines.zh: 那东西看起来不像叶子。
lines.en: That doesn't look like foliage.
Your hands smell of resin.
Lower it just a little.
I prefer ferns.
You can stand further away.
You touched my plates.
Those plates are hard.

lines.zh: 我的尾刺擦过你的膝盖。
lines.en: My tail spikes graze your knee.
My tail is right beside you.
You hit my hind leg.
I draw my tail back in.
I shifted half a step aside.
Needles crunch under both of us.
Don't push my flank.

lines.zh: 这地方容不下我们两个。
lines.en: This spot won't hold us both.
The herd decides that.
Not enough pine needles yet.
My companion waits behind the trees.

lines.zh: 针叶林里还有别的同类。
lines.en: There are others deeper in the pines.
That depends on the season.
Let this season pass.
I go back to eating.

lines.zh: 我只想找块安静的坡地。
lines.en: I only want a quiet slope.
I've turned my body away.
Don't speak of it on this path.
I take it in my mouth.
Stone, not fern.
This one is a stone.

lines.zh: 我把它推到一边，别挡蹄子。
lines.en: I shove it aside — clear of my hooves.
Bending is hard for me.
This branch will do.
It's tiny under my feet.
It crumbles under my foot.
I nudge the branch aside.
This fell on the pine needles.
Something's moving over there.
I've raised my head.
I turned toward it slowly.
I don't feel afraid of this.
First I bring my tail around.
My herdmates are watching too.
This gap is enough to turn in.
I've turned my body broadside.
It's standing in the open.
I close in with heavy steps.
First I plant myself here.
My plates have all risen up.
I aim my tail tip at it.
The tip of my tail quivers.
That thing still hasn't left.
I've turned my tail toward it.
I'm slowly walking backward.
That should keep it off.
It's circled to my flank.
I turn along with it.
The needles on the ground are slick.
It's right beside my tail.
I've lifted my tail tip.

lines.zh: 我背上那排板，立起来了。
lines.en: The plates on my back stand up.
One step more and I strike.
I keep my body facing it.
Its shadow is long on the ground.
I can hear it breathing.
I've lowered my rear.
I raise my tail spikes.
These needles are in the way.
My tail sweeps across!
The spikes are aimed at your legs.
I ram your flank.
My tail spike sweeps with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩出去带起一阵风。
lines.en: My tail swing raises a gust.
I sweep my tail again.
My plates caught you.
It hit my back and bounced.
My spikes sink into pine bark.
I press and push you back.
You slipped past on the flank.
My plate edge scrapes your armor.
I turn and lash the spikes out.
It fell onto the needles.
I drive in with my plates.
One more sweep of the tail.

lines.zh: 松针在我脚下很软，声音很小。
lines.en: Pine needles are soft underfoot, barely a sound.
My plates stand in rows.
The needles are soft underfoot.
This is better than open ground.
A herdmate called from the trees.
My plates slowly rise.
My tail sweeps aside dead branches.
I raise my head and sniff.
Tree shadow falls across me.
This patch is fairly level.
First a couple of mouthfuls of needles.
I turn my plates into the wind.
I've set all four feet.
The smell of firs surrounds me.
Something stirs deeper in the pines.
I begin to walk slowly.
Fire licked my plates.

lines.zh: 我的背板，比坡上的石头还硬。
lines.en: My plates are harder than the slope's stones.
The water here is deeper than I thought.
The blast struck my flank.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的板缝里。
lines.en: Something lodged between my plates.

lines.zh: 那光在背板上绕了一圈。
lines.en: That light circled my plates.

lines.zh: 这片林子的蕨类都被吃完了。
lines.en: The ferns here are all eaten.
Lightning hit my plates. Very loud.
Even this weight can't hold me.
